archive.tome.no_description: An enchantment whose purpose is not recorded in the Archive.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces fire damage and burn time. No longer obtainable; see Resilience.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Reduces explosion damage and knockback. No longer obtainable; see Resilience.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces projectile damage. No longer obtainable; see Resilience.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Damages attackers who hit you. Chestplates only.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Freezes water beneath your feet as you walk.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Once worn, this item can't be removed.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Increases damage against arthropods, and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: The item loses durability more slowly. No longer obtainable.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Shooting doesn't use up regular arrows.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Better chance of fishing up treasure.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: A thrown trident returns to you.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Increases trident damage against mobs in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Throwing the trident in water or rain launches you with it.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: A thrown trident summons lightning during thunderstorms.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Increases mace smash damage per block fallen.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Mace hits ignore part of the target's armor.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: A mace smash launches you back into the air.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: XP repairs the item. No longer obtainable.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: The item disappears when you die.
enchantment.archive.resilience.desc: Reduces damage from fire, explosions and projectiles, shortens burning, and reduces knockback. Chestplates only.
config.archive.title: Archive
config.archive.xpCurve.tooltip: Every level costs the same XP, up to a level cap.
config.archive.durability.tooltip: Archive's durability values for tools, weapons and armor.
config.archive.mining.tooltip: Tool mining speeds (faster diamond and netherite by default), softer deepslate and harder obsidian.
config.archive.grindstone.tooltip: Archive's single-slot grindstone with an XP refund.
config.archive.libraryTable.tooltip: The enchanting table opens the library menu instead of vanilla's.
config.archive.stripBookLoot.tooltip: Removes enchanted books from loot and villager trades.
config.archive.durabilityOverrides: Per-item durability overrides are set in config/archive.json (durabilityOverrides). Restart needed.
config.archive.xpPerLevel.tooltip: XP points needed for each level. Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.levelCap.tooltip: The highest level a player can reach. Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.deathXpFraction.tooltip: Fraction of a player's XP that drops when they die (0 to 1).
config.archive.tableRadius.tooltip: How far the table looks for bookshelves: a cube this many blocks out, so 4 = 9×9×9. Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.shelfSteps.tooltip: Plain bookshelves needed for each level unlocked without a tome. 0, 5, 10 = level I with none, II at 5, III at 10.
config.archive.tableShowLocked.tooltip: List every enchant that fits the item, with locked rows and hints. Off lists only what can be enchanted now. Display only.
config.archive.woodSpeed.tooltip: Mining speed of wooden tools (vanilla 2). Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.stoneSpeed.tooltip: Mining speed of stone tools (vanilla 4). Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.ironSpeed.tooltip: Mining speed of iron tools (vanilla 6). Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.goldSpeed.tooltip: Mining speed of golden tools (vanilla 12). Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.diamondSpeed.tooltip: Mining speed of diamond tools (vanilla 8). Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.netheriteSpeed.tooltip: Mining speed of netherite tools (vanilla 9). Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.deepslateHardnessReductio: Taken off the vanilla hardness of every deepslate block, ores included (1.0 makes deepslate 2.0 and its ores 3.5). Client and server should use the same value.
config.archive.obsidianHardness.tooltip: Hardness of obsidian blocks. Client and server should use the same value.
